traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The tough makes two attacks, using Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +5, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the tough pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.text: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +4, range 100/400 ft. _Hit:_ 13 (2d10 + 2) Piercing damage. ## Treant
